When Quentin Tarantino planted Kill Bill in Pulp Fiction and thought we wouldn’t notice.

A diner conversation that quietly shaped a future classic. In this diner scene Quentin Tarantino was already thinking about Kill Bill

The scene is important not just as exposition, but thematically—it reflects Tarantino’s fascination with pop culture, genre mashups, and strong female archetypes. 

It also foreshadows his later work, particularly Kill Bill, which many viewers see as a spiritual evolution of the Fox Force Five idea.

It’s widely understood as a deliberate Quentin Tarantino Easter egg and creative foreshadowing of Kill Bill. While Tarantino has never framed it as a formal “announcement,” the parallels are too precise to be accidental.
